source.curriculum: NaCCA Mathematics Common Core Programme (B7–B9), September 2020
source.notice: Learner-safe metadata excerpt only; full lessons and assessments remain under review.

lessons.title: Modelling Numbers Beyond One Billion

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate understanding and the use of place value for expressing quantities recorded as base ten numerals as well as rounding these to given decimal places and significant figures.

indicator.text: Model number quantities more than 1,000,000,000 using graph sheets, isometric papers and multi-base blocks.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners model and read whole numbers greater than one billion using multi-base blocks, graph sheets and place-value charts.

lessons.title: Comparing and Ordering Huge Numbers

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate understanding and the use of place value for expressing quantities recorded as base ten numerals as well as rounding these to given decimal places and significant figures.

indicator.text: Compare and order whole numbers more than 1,000,000,000 and represent the comparison using “>, <, or =”.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners compare and order whole numbers greater than one billion and record the comparison using >, < or =.

lessons.title: Rounding Whole Numbers

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate understanding and the use of place value for expressing quantities recorded as base ten numerals as well as rounding these to given decimal places and significant figures.

indicator.text: Round (off, up, down) whole numbers more than 1,000,000,000 to the nearest hundred-thousand, ten-thousands, thousands, hundreds and tens.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners round whole numbers greater than one billion to the nearest ten, hundred, thousand, ten-thousand and hundred-thousand.

lessons.title: Rounding Decimals

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate understanding and the use of place value for expressing quantities recorded as base ten numerals as well as rounding these to given decimal places and significant figures.

indicator.text: Round decimals to the nearest tenth, hundredth, thousandths, etc.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners round decimal numbers to the nearest tenth, hundredth and thousandth.

lessons.title: Decimal Places and Significant Figures

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate understanding and the use of place value for expressing quantities recorded as base ten numerals as well as rounding these to given decimal places and significant figures.

indicator.text: Express decimal numerals to given significant and decimal places.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners express decimal numbers to a given number of decimal places and to a given number of significant figures.

lessons.title: Multiplying and Dividing by Powers of Ten

contentStandard.text: Apply mental mathematics strategies and number properties used to solve problems.

indicator.text: Multiply and divide given numbers by powers of 10 including decimals and benchmark fractions.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners multiply and divide whole numbers, decimals and benchmark fractions by 10, 100, 1000 and other powers of ten.

lessons.title: Mental Mathematics Strategies

contentStandard.text: Apply mental mathematics strategies and number properties used to solve problems.

indicator.text: Apply mental mathematics strategies and number properties used to perform calculations.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners apply mental mathematics strategies and number properties to perform calculations without written methods.

lessons.title: Mental Strategies for Word Problems

contentStandard.text: Apply mental mathematics strategies and number properties used to solve problems.

indicator.text: Apply mental mathematics strategies to solve word problems.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners apply mental mathematics strategies to solve word problems.

lessons.title: Adding and Subtracting Four-Digit Numbers

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate an understanding of addition, subtraction, multiplication and division of (i) whole numbers, and (ii) decimal numbers, to solve problems.

indicator.text: Add and subtract up to four-digit numbers.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners add and subtract numbers up to four digits, including decimals, using partitioning and place value.

lessons.title: Multiplying and Dividing Multi-Digit Numbers

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate an understanding of addition, subtraction, multiplication and division of (i) whole numbers, and (ii) decimal numbers, to solve problems.

indicator.text: Multiply or divide multi-digit numbers by 1- and 2-digit numbers.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners multiply and divide multi-digit numbers by one- and two-digit numbers using partitioning, place value and the distributive property.

lessons.title: Story Problems with Decimals

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate an understanding of addition, subtraction, multiplication and division of (i) whole numbers, and (ii) decimal numbers, to solve problems.

indicator.text: Create and solve story problems involving decimals on the four basic operations.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners create and solve story problems involving decimals using all four operations.

lessons.title: Repeated Factors — The Idea of Powers

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate understanding and the use of powers of natural numbers in solving problems.

indicator.text: Illustrate with examples the meaning of repeated factors using counting objects such as bottle tops or bundle sticks.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners illustrate the meaning of repeated factors using concrete objects and write the shorthand index form.

lessons.title: Writing Numbers as Products and Powers

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate understanding and the use of powers of natural numbers in solving problems.

indicator.text: Express a given number as a product of a given number or numbers, as well as, in the form of a power or two such numbers as product of powers.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners express a number as a product of factors, and write that product in index form including as a product of powers.

lessons.title: The Zero Index

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate understanding and the use of powers of natural numbers in solving problems.

indicator.text: Show that the value of any natural number with zero as its exponent or index is 1 and use it to solve problems.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners show that any natural number raised to the power zero equals 1, and use this to solve problems.

lessons.title: Evaluating Numbers in Index Form

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate understanding and the use of powers of natural numbers in solving problems.

indicator.text: Find the value of a number written in index form.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners find the value of a number written in index form, including products of powers and zero indices.

lessons.title: Prime Factors and the Highest Common Factor

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate understanding and the use of powers of natural numbers in solving problems.

indicator.text: Apply the concept of powers of numbers (product of prime) to find Highest Common Factor (HCF).

lessons.learningGoal: Learners use prime factorisation to find the Highest Common Factor of two or more numbers.

lessons.title: Benchmark Fractions, Decimals and Percentages

contentStandard.text: Simplify, compare and order a mixture of positive fractions (i.e. common, percent and decimal) by changing all to equivalent (i) fractions, (ii) decimals, or (iii) percentages.

indicator.text: Determine and recall the percentages and decimals of given benchmark fractions (i.e. tenths, fifths, fourths, thirds and halves) and use these to compare quantities.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners recall the decimal and percentage equivalents of benchmark fractions and use them to compare quantities.

lessons.title: Comparing and Ordering Fractions

contentStandard.text: Simplify, compare and order a mixture of positive fractions (i.e. common, percent and decimal) by changing all to equivalent (i) fractions, (ii) decimals, or (iii) percentages.

indicator.text: Compare and order fractions (i.e. common, percent and decimal fractions up to thousandths) limit to the benchmark fractions.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners compare and order common, decimal and percentage fractions, limited to the benchmarks, by converting them all to the same form.

lessons.title: Adding and Subtracting Unlike and Mixed Fractions

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate an understanding of the process of addition and/or subtraction of fractions and apply this in solving problems.

indicator.text: Explain the process of addition and subtraction of two or three unlike and mixed fractions.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners explain and carry out addition and subtraction of two or three unlike and mixed fractions.

lessons.title: Solving Problems with Fraction Addition and Subtraction

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate an understanding of the process of addition and/or subtraction of fractions and apply this in solving problems.

indicator.text: Solve problems involving addition or subtraction of fractions.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners solve word problems involving the addition and subtraction of fractions.

lessons.title: Multiplying Fractions

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate an understanding of the process of multiplying and dividing positive fractions and apply this in solving problems.

indicator.text: Explain the process of multiplying a fraction (i.e. common, percent and decimal fractions up to thousandths) by a whole number and by a fraction.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners explain and carry out multiplication of a fraction by a whole number and by another fraction.

lessons.title: Finding a Fraction of a Quantity

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate an understanding of the process of multiplying and dividing positive fractions and apply this in solving problems.

indicator.text: Find a fraction of given quantity (i.e. money or given quantity of objects).

lessons.learningGoal: Learners find a fraction of a given quantity of money or objects.

lessons.title: Dividing Fractions

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate an understanding of the process of multiplying and dividing positive fractions and apply this in solving problems.

indicator.text: Explain the process of dividing a fraction (i.e. common, percent and decimal fractions up to thousandths) by a 1-digit whole number and by a fraction.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners explain and carry out division of a fraction by a one-digit whole number and by another fraction.

lessons.title: Dividing Quantities and Fractions by Fractions

contentStandard.text: Demonstrate an understanding of the process of multiplying and dividing positive fractions and apply this in solving problems.

indicator.text: Determine the result of dividing a quantity (i.e. money or objects) or a fraction by a fraction.

lessons.learningGoal: Learners determine the result of dividing a quantity of money or objects, or a fraction, by a fraction.
